Distinct in framing from the Fulcrum-led 'Guyana LNG Terminal' already in GEM, BUT no separate site, capacity, FEED, or sponsor structure has been announced, and the discussions are part of the same Exxon-Fulcrum-government process. notes: Likely NOT a separate terminal — most reporting has Exxon supplying profit gas to Fulcrum's facility, which is the existing GEM record (T100001061364).
